item.title: Feri, My LLM Coach
item.description:
In the post about Obsidian and Claude Feri got one paragraph, as the only agent in my vault named after a real person. He deserves a post, because he is the reason the rest of the health machinery exists. The watch, the lifting app, the daily export, the scripts that turn it all into notes: none of that was the goal. The goal was to have a coach again.

The real Feri
#

I got my first personal trainer in Spain. His name was Carles and he was fantastic. We originally started working on certain pains and injuries I had picked up while pushing myself to performance levels that were, in hindsight, obviously meant for younger and fitter bodies. Carles was very well versed in physiotherapy and his exercises worked.
